_note: Built from the 19 Oct route video. Shape, turn directions, door sides and sign choices come from the video. LENGTHS ARE VIDEO-TIMING ESTIMATES (~1.2 m/s, roughly +/-25%): tape-measure S1, S2, S3 and replace. Fields starting with _ are ignored.
name: Cheers to E3-06-02, toilet and back

segments._video: 0:00-0:21. Start with your back to Cheers, facing down the main corridor. E3-06-02 has two doors on the LEFT, both plated 'Tutorial Room (E3-06-02)'. Plates sit in door recesses and can only be read when facing the door.
segments.startInstruction: With your back to Cheers, walk straight ahead down the main corridor.
segments.arrivalMessage: You are at the door of tutorial room E3-06-02.

segments._video: 0:21-1:11. ~8 m to the second E3-06-02 door, then a long corridor with no forward-facing signs until the EXIT sign above the double doors at the end. Turn LEFT at the end (the lift lobby is to the right).
segments.startInstruction: Turn right to face along the corridor, then walk straight. This is a long corridor.

landmarks._note: ceiling EXIT sign above the double doors at the corridor end, facing you as you walk

segments._video: 1:11-1:37. Past the Active Learning Room (E3-06-07) at the corner, into the narrow open-air walkway (tiled floor). Male toilet door is on the LEFT; it has a pictogram only, no text, so arrival is by step count.
segments.startInstruction: Walk straight along the narrow walkway. The toilet is on your left near the end.
segments.arrivalMessage: You have arrived at the male toilet. The door is on your left.

segments._video: 1:39-1:54. Back along the walkway; turn RIGHT into the main corridor.
segments.startInstruction: Turn around, then walk straight back along the walkway.

segments._video: 1:55-2:39. Long corridor back towards Cheers (the Cheers sign is visible far ahead). First E3-06-02 door met is on the RIGHT.
segments.startInstruction: Walk straight back along the long corridor towards E3-06-02.
segments.arrivalMessage: You are back at tutorial room E3-06-02.
